whatItIs: The Empressa Command Center (deployed as Vercel project `cmdcenter`, live alias cmdcenter-blush.vercel.app, app source at hauska-map/apps/command-center) is the INTERNAL operator console for the spine: the single surface where an operator sees the true state of the whole machine rather than a single property. Its documented job is fourfold. First, it is the factory floor (OPS-6): the County Ledger showing all 254 Texas counties and their cities with per-rail coverage, gate verdicts, cert state, recipe-version drift, source vintage and staleness, open defect classes and focused-fix counts, so an operator can watch a jurisdiction come online and can run the required operator-R6 visual QA gate in the Cert View before anything may be called certified. Second, it is the node-and-graph ledger (27a/27b F1): a live tally of nodes, atoms, present-versus-honest-absent facets and references read by a live query against the serving DB, bidirectionally bound to the map on one canonical node id, so that a coverage number not in the ledger does not exist. Third, it is the operator's engine and governance cockpit: per-panel LIVE/STUB badges that as of F1c are mechanically computed from whether a panel can actually serve its data rather than hand-set, plus MCP tool introspection, atom inspector, revenue meter, run monitor and spine-health probes. Fourth, it is the composition sandbox the bizdev function matrix sells as tiles and workspaces. Its relationship to the customer surface is a hard, repeatedly restated ruling: Command Center is INTERNAL and shows the whole machine; Property Explorer / Smart Site is the CUSTOMER app and shows a curated, customer-safe parcel view exposing zero engine or governance panels. They share the spine substrate, the node model, the one read path and the map-renderer component library, and they live in the same repo as hauska-map/apps/*, but they are two products with two audiences and must never be collapsed into one another. Build state per the docs: the F1 completion program (27b) graded its WDLL items MET across gates A, B, C and F1c on 2026-07-25; the County Ledger v2 shipped 2026-08-04 reading the factory's own artifacts; the rail-list derivation fix landed 2026-08-12 (PR 158) making the manifest columns derive from the API instead of a hardcoded array. Against that, OPS-6 (2026-08-02) still records the Resolver and Autonomous Engines panels as explicit stubs with the factory-floor panels unwired, and a 2026-08-14 code audit found the command-center src tree contains only admin/, main.tsx, test/ and vite-env.d.ts with zero workspace or Smart Files surface. So: the ledger and manifest legs are documented live; the engine-state, freeze/memory, rewarm-control and cert-view legs are documented as not yet wired.

patterns: case-insensitive extended regex: command[ _-]?center|cmdcenter  (covers 'Command Center', 'command center', 'command-center', 'command_center', 'cmdcenter')
case-SENSITIVE word-boundary: \bCC\b  (the bare abbreviation, run separately because it is known-noisy)
filename regex: command[-_ ]?center|cmdcenter|command_center  over the full file tree
filename regex: (^|[/_-])CC([_-]|\.)  to catch CC-prefixed artifact filenames
paths: EXCLUDED by prune: .git/, node_modules/, hauska-mcp-server/ (nested foreign clone), tmpbrief-l3-spine-consume/ (nested foreign clone)
searchMethod.countingRule: A file counts once no matter how many times the pattern appears in it (grep -l semantics). Per-file hit counts reported separately are grep -c line counts, i.e. MATCHING LINES not match occurrences, so a line containing 'Command Center' twice counts once. Directory distribution is computed from the first path segment of the file list; ROOT means a top-level file with no directory segment.
searchMethod.falsePositiveHandling: The bare token CC is dominated by CC&R (covenants, conditions and restrictions -- the recorded-private-encumbrance layer, ADR-020/021, doc 49b), which has nothing to do with the console. Method: take the 195 files matching \bCC\b, subtract the 231-file phrase list to isolate 112 CC-only files, then re-test each for a bare CC occurrence NOT followed by &R. Result: 44 of 112 (39.3 percent) were CC&R-only pure false positives and were dropped. Of the remaining 68, two more were verified by eye as unrelated: _scratch/tx_registry_fetch_hays/sm_z26.json (a Hays zoning district literally coded 'CC') and _inbox/2026-07-14_cotality_mcp_eval_agreement_signed.md ('Michelle Taylor CC'd', email carbon copy). Net console-sense bare-CC files: 66. PRECISION OF THE BARE-CC PATTERN ALONE: 66 of 195 files = 33.8 percent; that is why the phrase pattern, not the abbreviation, is the primary instrument. The phrase pattern was spot-checked and produced no observed false positives.

counts.reconciliationNote: 231 file total equals the sum of the per-directory distribution, so no file is double-counted or dropped.
counts.unionNoteAfterInspectionDrops: 299 minus the 2 inspection drops = 297 files in doc_repo carry a plausible Command Center reference.

authoritativeDocExplanation: There is NO single authoritative Command Center document and no home, and that absence is the finding. What exists is authority SPLIT BY QUESTION with no doc that composes it and no read-order that reaches most of it. WHICH CONSOLE WINS AND WHAT THE LIBRARY IS -> _decisions/2026-07-04_master_map_and_console_unification.md (active). WHERE CC LIVES AND WHETHER IT SURVIVES -> _catalog/repo_intents.md (ratified, CLAUDE.md-mandated reading). WHAT CC MUST SHOW AS FACTORY FLOOR -> 90_operations/OPS-6 (target-state; its own STUB assessment now partly overtaken). WHAT CC'S LEDGER CAN AND CANNOT SEE -> OPS-12. WHY CC IS A REQUIRED GATE -> OPS-5 (operator R6 happens in CC). WHAT CC WORK REMAINS OPEN -> 90_operations/QUEUE_parked_work_index.md. THE PROGRAM THAT BUILT IT -> 27b (whose contract 27a is superseded). WHAT IT IS IN CUSTOMER LANGUAGE -> the 2026-07-16 function matrix (self-declared aspirational). THE OPERATOR HOLD ON NEW CC WORK -> the frontmatter of _inbox/2026-07-28_pe_cc_qa_and_reports_spec.md and nowhere else. THE INTENDED MANIFEST UX -> a FAKE-DATA mockup parked in _scratch. Nothing carries a CC id in a numeric band except OPS-6; nothing appears in 00b_doc_repo_guide's key-entry-points table; and 00c_portfolio_master_map -- the doc whose job is to enumerate surfaces -- does not list CC as a surface at all, mentioning it only as 'a scaffolded command-center app' consuming the SDK. An agent asked 'where is the Command Center documented' has no correct single answer to give.

proposedHome.rationale: Two viable homes, and the recommendation is BOTH with a clear split of duty. PRIMARY: open a root numeric slot as the canonical Command Center doc -- what CC is, the CC-versus-PE two-products ruling in its surviving canonical form, the panel inventory, the authority map above (which doc rules which question), the deploy identity (Vercel project cmdcenter / cmdcenter-blush, NOT command-center/jade) and its two traps, and a pointer list to the six evidence clusters. A root-band doc is the only placement that (a) can be added to 00b_doc_repo_guide's key-entry-points table and 00c_portfolio_master_map's surface list, which is where the discoverability failure actually lives, and (b) is not scoped to the factory. findings: F1. THE HEADLINE: there is no authoritative Command Center document and no home. Authority is split across at least eight docs by question (the unification decision, repo_intents, OPS-6, OPS-12, OPS-5, the QUEUE index, 27b/27a, the bizdev function matrix), and no doc composes them. The absence is the finding and it is the reason this task exists.

F2. Coverage of the material is wide and shallow: 231 files carry the phrase pattern, plus 66 more that use only the bare CC abbreviation in the console sense, across 22 directories -- but only ONE file in the whole repo has command_center in its name at a canonical band position (90_operations/OPS-6), and only one root doc is CC-titled (27b, whose implemented contract is superseded).

F3. HALF THE MASS IS IN _inbox: 116 of the 231 phrase-matching files (50.2 percent) are in _inbox, the courier drop the planner is supposed to sweep. The load-bearing operator HOLD on new CC complexity ('operator PAUSED adding new CC complexity ... the broader report/function build stays HELD') exists ONLY in the frontmatter of _inbox/2026-07-28_pe_cc_qa_and_reports_spec.md.

F4. The evidence clusters naturally into six: (i) ORIGIN, 2026-06-30 to 07-04 -- the E1-E7 close, the phase-2 spine admin console close, the trading-console scout, the unification decision; (ii) F1 COMPLETION, 2026-07-25 -- 27a spec, 27b program, the F1a audit, four gate check-ins, one session close; (iii) CC-A, 2026-07-27 -- 13 files comprising a dispatch, a WDLL, three executor closes, three planner verifies, a fanout check-in, a rollup and two post-deploy live verifies; (iv) PE+CC QA, 2026-07-28 -- spec plus session, carrying the operator hold; (v) OPERATIONS DOCTRINE, 2026-08-02 onward -- OPS-6, OPS-INDEX, OPS-5, OPS-8, OPS-10, OPS-12, five PHASE_C files, PHASE_D; (vi) MANIFEST ERA, 2026-08-08 to 08-12 -- the _scratch mockup, the ten-rail spec, the E2 rail-derivation close.

F5. PRECISION WARNING FOR FUTURE SEARCHES, quantified: the bare token CC has 33.8 percent precision in this repo (66 console-sense of 195 matching files). The dominant confounder is CC&R (covenants, conditions and restrictions -- the recorded-encumbrance layer, ADR-020/021, doc 49b), accounting for 44 of the 112 CC-only files. Two further confounders: a Hays zoning district literally coded 'CC' in _scratch/tx_registry_fetch_hays/sm_z26.json, and email carbon-copy ('Michelle Taylor CC'd'). Use the phrase pattern as the primary instrument; use bare CC only as a supplement with CC&R filtered.

F6. Both spellings of the deploy target appear, and the docs are internally CORRECT about the trap. The live project is cmdcenter (alias cmdcenter-blush.vercel.app); command-center/jade is a parallel dead project, recorded as a zombie in _inbox/2026-08-02_ZOMBIE_CODE_cleanup_ledger.md section C and carried as an open operator decision in QUEUE_parked_work_index (delete or explicitly label not-live). The project-name trap is stated in two independent places (OPS-INDEX trap list, E2 close findings), which is why it has stopped biting on that axis -- though the E2 close documents a SECOND, distinct deploy trap on the directory axis (root .vercel linked to property-explorer; deploying from inside apps/command-center breaks workspace resolution).

F7. THE RICHEST DESIGN ARTIFACT IS ORPHANED. _scratch/command_center_manifest_mockup.html is 120,825 bytes of operator-reviewed v2 County Manifest UX (time axis, since-you-last-looked diff strip, in-flight run state, heavy-scan serializer slot, per-cell trustworthiness with last-verified and by-which-instrument). It is correctly and loudly labelled FAKE DATA and sits in _scratch, which no read-order reaches.

F8. CC IS A REQUIRED GATE, NOT A DASHBOARD. OPS-5 makes operator R6 live QA a required cert gate and OPS-2 places it 'in CC'; OPS-6 argues the console is foundational rather than later polish precisely because R6 happens there and rewarm-triggering happens there; PHASE_C_mechanism_vs_prose_SPEC puts CC in the target onboard(fips) chain ('... -> ledger -> CC -> halt for R6'). Anything blocking CC blocks certification. This is the strongest argument that CC deserves a canonical home rather than scattered operational mentions.

F9. Three CC defects are recorded in passing and appear to have no owning dispatch: the absenceBasis and isPartial renders the panel owes (QUEUE index, routed to a lane but not dispatched); the >100 percent CC display ratio bug (PHASE_D, noted 'don't fix inline'); and ActiveContextBar.tsx's real type errors (E2 close, explicitly 'deserves its own dispatch'). None live in a CC-owned register because there is no CC-owned register.

F10. There is a design principle recorded AGAINST building things into CC: the QUEUE index's M2 note recommends the canon-versus-reality divergence detector be script-written markdown FIRST, 'not the Command Center', because 'the mechanism that watches for drift must not itself carry a five-service deploy dependency'. That is a real constraint on CC's scope and it exists in one line of a parked-work index.

F11. Doc 34's false command-center claim is duplicated. The sentence ruled false by OPS-17 A-003 exists both at _smartcity_masters/34_smartcity_smart_files_and_foundation.md line 32 and in an untracked copy at 'Master Collateral Folder/_smartcity_masters/34_smartcity_smart_files_and_foundation.md'. A scoped in-place correction to one leaves the other standing.

F12. Two guaranteed-read docs already touch CC and could carry a pointer at near-zero cost: _catalog/repo_intents.md (CLAUDE.md read-order item 5, already carrying the hauska-map row that rules on the console) and _inbox/2026-07-04_convergence-program_STATUS.md (CLAUDE.md instructs reading it before touching program repos). 00b_doc_repo_guide.md's 'Key entry points' table has no CC row and is the natural insertion point.
